highlights: A paired device's running sessions now attach to their server, so `arterm device sessions` and the session picker show real counts instead of an orphaned pile
fixes: The server registry's per-server session list is written as clients attach, follow resume and /clear, and is dropped on disconnect
A server re-registering (reload race) no longer wipes the session ownership it had recorded
/session and /sessions no longer appear twice in the command palette
